source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: measure unnecessary calls, tool success, final correctness, trajectory length, tool latency, and recovery; add a stop/no-tool evaluation and preference or reward signal.
corrected_answer: Assumptions: pin the model, calculator implementation/version, precision and rounding rules, workload mix, service load, and correctness adjudicator; platform facts and cost/latency are measured, not guessed. Define an unnecessary call as one for which a no-tool response is correct at the requested precision and independent adjudication agrees. Define justified use as a call needed for error-prone or large arithmetic, unit conversion, uncertainty propagation, missing intermediates, or explicit verification. Ambiguous operands, units, sign, rounding, or precision require clarification or conservative abstention. Intervention: add a typed stop/no-tool gate recording task class, difficulty, precision, rationale, and expected correctness gain; call only when that gain exceeds measured latency/cost. Deduplicate expressions, cap calls and retries, validate tool responses, and fail closed on timeout, malformed output, disagreement, or unavailable authorization. Evaluate on a locked, stratified, contamination-controlled set with baseline versus intervention in randomized paired trials, preserving no-tool and tool-required slices. Measure unnecessary-call rate, justified-use recall, call rate, tool success/error/timeout/wrong-result rates, final correctness, abstention and clarification rates, trajectory length, calls/retries, recovery rate, tool and end-to-end latency in milliseconds, and token/currency cost with confidence intervals. Redact or hash private expressions and enforce authorization, retention, and access controls. Falsifiable hypothesis: versus baseline, the intervention reduces unnecessary-call rate and median/p95 latency and cost by predeclared amounts while final correctness remains within a predeclared non-inferiority margin and justified-use recall stays above its floor on the held-out set. Test with paired bootstrap or cluster-aware analysis, report effect sizes and uncertainty, and keep tuning separate from evaluation. Expected confounders include task mix/difficulty, prompt or model drift, arithmetic precision, cache/warm-up, concurrency/load, tool version and failures, evaluator disagreement, and reward-induced verbosity; stratify or randomize, log versions, and run malformed, adversarial, timeout, wrong-result, duplicate, retry-loop, unavailable-tool, ambiguity, and precision-boundary tests. Use reward/preference signals only behind correctness and safety gates; do not reward abstention that hides errors. Roll back the gate or reward change if correctness, justified-use recall, safety, privacy, authorization, recovery, or latency guardrails breach predeclared thresholds; canary gradually and retain an auditable, reversible configuration.
